What Makes a Great Controller for GTA VI? Key Features for Open-World Gaming

by Emma Hamill 16 Nov 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:46
Instaread

The long wait is finally over, and GTA VI is here. Whether you're cruising through Vice City, getting into intense shootouts, exploring every corner of the map, or trying to escape a five-star police chase, there's no shortage of things to do. With so much variety packed into one game, having the right controller can make a big difference in how comfortable and enjoyable your experience feels. 

The best controller for GTA VI isn't necessarily the one that makes you a better player overnight. Instead, it's about finding the right balance of comfort, precision, responsiveness, and control that matches your playstyle. Whether you're spending hours exploring the open world or jumping between driving, combat, and missions, a quality controller helps you stay comfortable and in control for longer gaming sessions. 

Why Precision and Control Matter in GTA VI 

Open-world games like GTA VI put your controller through a wide range of scenarios in a single play session. One moment you're weaving through traffic at high speeds, and the next you're in a fast-paced gunfight or navigating a complex mission objective. Each situation demands a different level of precision and responsiveness.

  • Driving and Vehicle Control: Tight turns, high-speed pursuits, and navigating crowded streets require smooth, accurate thumb stick movement. Precise analog control allows for small steering adjustments when every second counts. 
  • Combat and Targeting: Whether you're taking cover during a firefight or reacting to unexpected encounters, responsive controls help ensure your actions happen when you need them to. 
  • Fast-Paced Gameplay: Switching weapons, deploying equipment, or reacting to changing situations becomes easier when essential actions are within a comfortable reach. 

Choosing the Best HyperX Controller for Your Gaming Style 

Every gamer approach open-world games differently. Some prioritize customization and premium features, while others prefer a straightforward plug-and-play experience or a controller that better fits smaller hands. That's why HyperX offers multiple controller options designed to support different playstyles, setups, and budgets. 

  1. HyperX Clutch Talon – For Players Who Want Premium Wireless Freedom 

Best For: Gamers who want wireless freedom, extensive customization, and greater control over their gaming experience across PC and console such as Xbox and PlayStation. 

For players who prefer a cable-free setup, the HyperX Clutch Talon offers the flexibility to customize how your controller feels and responds across different gameplay scenarios. Whether you're navigating city streets, engaging in combat, or exploring the open world, its customizable controls help you tailor the experience to your preferences. 

Key Features: 

  • Drift-Free Hall Effect Sticks and Triggers: Magnetic Hall Effect technology helps eliminate stick drift caused by wear, providing smooth steering, aiming, and acceleration over time. 
  • Tool-Free Customization and Back Paddles: Easily swap thumb sticks, triggers, and D-pads, while mapping frequently used actions to rear paddles for quicker access. 
  • 3-Stage Trigger Locks: Switch between full trigger travel for precise driving control or shorter trigger pulls for faster reactions during combat. 
  • Dual Wireless Connectivity: Connect through ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless or Bluetooth for flexibility across different gaming setups. 
  • HyperX NGENUITY Customization: Personalize controller settings and controls to suit your preferred playstyle. 
  • 30-Hour Battery Life: Spend more time gaming and less time worrying about recharging. 

Why it's a great fit for GTA VI: The Clutch Talon delivers a premium experience for players who want wireless performance, deep customization, and the flexibility to adapt controls for everything from high-speed pursuits to intense firefights. 

  1. HyperX Clutch Gladiate – For Players Who Want Plug-and-Play Simplicity 

Best For: Gamers looking for an affordable wired controller with useful customization features and responsive controls. 

Not every player needs a wireless controller. If you'd rather plug in and jump straight into the action, the HyperX Clutch Gladiate offers a straightforward gaming experience while still providing features that can enhance control and comfort. 

Key Features: 

  • Dual Trigger Locks: Adjust trigger travel distance to react more quickly during fast-paced combat encounters. 
  • Programmable Rear Buttons: Keep your thumbs on the thumb sticks while accessing important controls through two programmable rear buttons. During a high-speed chase or intense mission, this can help you maintain control without constantly repositioning your hands. 
  • Dual Rumble Motors: Feel the impact of collisions, explosions, and vehicle movement through immersive vibration feedback that helps bring GTA VI's world to life. 
  • Wired Connectivity: Plug-and-play USB connectivity provides a reliable connection with no batteries to charge, and no wireless pairing required. 

Why it's a great fit for GTA VI: The Clutch Gladiate is ideal for players who want to plug in and start playing immediately while still benefiting from extra controls and responsive performance. 

  1. HyperX Tanto Mini – For Players Who Prefer a More Compact Controller 

Best For: Younger gamers, players with smaller hands, or anyone who prefers a compact and lightweight controller. 

A controller doesn't need to be full-sized to deliver a great gaming experience. The HyperX Tanto Mini takes the familiar Xbox layout and packages it into a smaller, lighter design that's easier to hold for extended gaming sessions. 

Key Features: 

  • Compact Design: A scaled-down profile creates a more comfortable grip for players with smaller hands and those who find traditional controllers bulky. 
  • Official Xbox Licensing: Compatible with Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC right out of the box. 
  • Lightweight and Travel-Ready: Easy to carry for gaming on the go or casual multiplayer sessions. 
  • Built-In 3.5mm Audio Jack: Connect a compatible headset directly to the controller for in-game audio and communication. 

Why it's a great fit for GTA VI: Players with smaller hands often find standard controllers uncomfortable during long sessions. The Tanto Mini offers a more natural grip and easier access to controls, making it a comfortable option for exploring Vice City, completing missions, and enjoying extended play sessions. 

Find the Right Controller for Your GTA VI Adventure 

No matter how you choose to experience GTA VI, the right controller can make a noticeable difference in comfort, precision, and overall gameplay. Whether you're looking for the wireless freedom and extensive customization of the HyperX Clutch Talon, the straightforward plug-and-play performance of the Clutch Gladiate, or the compact comfort of the Tanto Mini, HyperX offers options designed to fit different gaming preferences, setups, and budgets. 

Find the controller that matches your playstyle and get ready to make the most of every adventure in Vice City.

Your Privacy

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
Please visit our Use of Cookies and other Technologies Notice for more information.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Performance & Analytics Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Personalization Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages.If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites.If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
